children: BioMarin completed the acquisition of Alesta, which is now a wholly owned subsidiary following the August 31, 2026 closing.
BioMarin executed a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire Alesta via a share purchase transaction.
The parties closed the Share Purchase on August 31, 2026, making Alesta a wholly owned subsidiary of BioMarin.
Terms of the Purchase Agreement are filed as Exhibit 2.1 to BioMarin’s Aug. 18, 2026 Form 8-K and are incorporated by reference.
